input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Without You I'm Nothing"?

documents.text: Without You I'm Nothing (Placebo album) Without You I'm Nothing is the second studio album by English alternative rock band Placebo. Recorded in mid-to-late 1998, it was released on 12 October 1998 by record labels Hut and Virgin Records. The album was a critical and commercial success, peaking at number seven in the UK Albums Chart and at number 20 on the US "Billboard" Heatseekers Albums chart.
